method: Real local HTTP and TCP sockets, unmodified InterfaceServer, isolated test-only fault relay
paid_mode: random with current weighted complete-round distribution

observations.scenario: Connection disappears after debit/result, before response
observations.outcome: Same-ID retry returned identical round; one debit and one settlement

observations.scenario: Only half the JSON response arrives
observations.outcome: Retry recovered complete identical round; no duplicate debit
No wallet change during outage; same-ID recovery settled once

observations.scenario: Gateway 503 after engine has already settled
observations.outcome: Same-ID recovery returned settled result without second charge

observations.scenario: Response delayed beyond client timeout while original socket remains open
observations.outcome: Concurrent same-ID retry recovered one settled round

observations.scenario: Eight simultaneous reconnect retries after response loss
observations.outcome: All eight received same round ID and one wallet settlement

observations.scenario: Connection closes before HTTP headers/body complete
observations.outcome: Incomplete request caused no debit or round

observations.scenario: Upload closes halfway through JSON request
observations.outcome: 400 response with no debit; complete retry settled once

observations.scenario: Local engine unavailable before a round, then restarted
observations.outcome: Outage produced 503; stale-cookie replay rejected409 without creating or charging a session; explicit state reload allowed fresh play

observations.scenario: Restart after paid settlement and lost response, then replay old request ID
observations.outcome: Stale session rejected409 and never resettled automatically; original virtual wallet/history remain unrecoverable because memory was lost

observations.scenario: Spin attempted with no established session cookie
observations.outcome: 409 session_expired with no new session or debit; state bootstrap required before first paid spin

observations.scenario: Retry old paid ID after its full result leaves the 100-entry response cache
observations.outcome: Tombstone retained:409 result_expired and no duplicate settlement; old full response is no longer replayable

observations.scenario: Page reload after lost response with existing session cookie
observations.outcome: State endpoint recovered settled round and balance without another spin

observations.scenario: 24h expiry simulated by aging isolated session fixture
observations.outcome: RealHTTP spin rejected409 without debit or replacement session; no 24h wall-clock wait was used

observations.scenario: Cookie survives but session-identity header is missing or stale
observations.outcome: Both rejected409 session_changed; zero wallet changes

observations.scenario: Another tab resets while disconnected tab retries old paid request
observations.outcome: Rotated session identity blocked stale retry409; reset wallet remained untouched

observations.scenario: 100k processed-ID guard simulated by filling isolated bookkeeping fixture
observations.outcome: New paid request rejected409 without debit; explicit reset rotated identity and allowed fresh play

scope: Loopback client-server transport failures; no real Stake RGS or wallet provider is connected
